newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.02 up at 41.20 to the dollar on Friday and is likely to open steady on Saturday amid balanced demand and supply of the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The State Bank (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on April 23, was 40.2400/40.4412 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.55 percent compared to the previous close of 2.60 percent on Wednesday before the May Day holiday on Friday.
